_about: Public-domain Archibald Alison (1757-1839), Episcopal minister of St Paul's Chapel, Cowgate, Edinburgh, for the Word Hoard: Sermons chiefly on Particular Occasions, a 1809 fast-day discourse, and his Essays on the Nature and Principles of Taste. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 113 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

aalison-sermons: Sermons, chiefly on particular occasions, vol. 1 (Boston : Wells and Lilly, 1815)
aalison-discourse-1809: A discourse preached in the Episcopal Chapel, Cowgate, Edinburgh, Feb. 9, 1809; being the day approved by His Majesty for a general fast (Edinburgh : G. Ramsay for A. Constable, etc., 1810)
aalison-taste: Essays on the nature and principles of taste (Edinburgh : Printed by J. J. G. and G. Robinson, London; and Bell and Bradfute, Edinburgh, 1790)

_excluded.aalison-historian: The histories of Europe are by his son Sir Archibald Alison
